title: Griddled Holey English Crumpets with Butter
summary: A loose yeast batter of flour, milk and water is left to bubble, lifted with baking powder, then cooked slowly in buttered rings on a covered pan until the tops are riddled with holes, flipped briefly and served hot with butter.
equipment: large heavy non-stick frying pan with a lid
4 crumpet rings or 9 cm metal pastry rings, buttered

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
unsalted butter, for the rings and pan

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Whisk the batter for 2 minutes and leave it to bubble for an hour.

steps.title: Activate
steps.text: Stir in the baking powder mixture and rest 10 minutes.

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Warm the buttered rings in the pan over medium-low heat.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Fill the rings and cook slowly until the surface is full of holes and set.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Remove the rings, flip and colour the tops lightly.

tips: Keep the heat gentle so the base browns while the top sets.
If no holes appear, the batter is too thick; whisk in a little warm water.
Butter the rings well every time so the crumpets release cleanly.
storage: Cool on a rack and keep airtight for up to 2 days, or freeze for up to 1 month. Toast before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
